name: chord
description: Hosted no-key MCP: DEX swap quotes and unsigned txs on 7 EVM chains (Base, Monad, BNB Chain, Avalanche, Arbitrum, Robinhood Chain, Arc), token boards, candles, trades, wallet PnL, smart money, holders and LP pools (Solana data read-only). About 60 requests a minute without a key; only chord_ask needs a Chord API key. Non-custodial: swap tools return unsigned transactions.

tools.name: chord_chains
tools.description: The chains Chord serves, with their native asset, anchors and which capabilities each one has (overview, tokens, trades, candles, wallet PnL, smart money, holders, LP, quote, swap). Call this first when unsure what a chain supports.

tools.name: chord_status
tools.description: Live health of every chain: routing engine state, how old the newest indexed trade is, and the public status page link.

tools.name: chord_overview
tools.description: A chain's last 24 hours on the venues Chord indexes: volume, swaps, venue share, hourly buckets.

tools.name: chord_tokens
tools.description: The chain's 24h token board: price, volume, trades, change. Sort names differ by chain; a wrong one is answered with the allowed list.

tools.name: chord_search
tools.description: Find a token on one chain by symbol, name or address. Returns candidates with their addresses; similar tickers are common, so compare addresses.

tools.name: chord_token
tools.description: One token on one chain: price, 24h volume and trades, pools or venues, and what the index knows about it.

tools.name: chord_trades
tools.description: The newest swaps of a token, with side, size in USD, price, venue and the wallet where it is known.

tools.name: chord_candles
tools.description: OHLCV candles of a token from Chord's own index.

tools.name: chord_wallet
tools.description: A wallet's trading result on one chain: realised and open PnL per token. Windows differ by chain and are stated in the answer.

tools.name: chord_wallet_trades
tools.description: A wallet's recent swaps on one chain. Not every chain has this; chord_chains says which.

tools.name: chord_smart_money
tools.description: Wallets ranked by profit on one chain, bots removed. Not every chain has this board.

tools.name: chord_holders
tools.description: Holder ledger of a token (balances by address) on the chains that keep one.

tools.name: chord_lp_pools
tools.description: Pools ranked for a liquidity provider: volume, fees, TVL, fee/TVL.

tools.name: chord_lp_positions
tools.description: A wallet's liquidity positions on one chain: range, value, fees, in or out of range.

tools.name: chord_quote
tools.description: Best swap quote on an EVM chain. Chord's own router answers first; another aggregator only when Chord cannot route. Amounts are integer strings in the token's smallest unit; the zero address is the native asset. Returns a quoteId valid for 2 minutes.

tools.name: chord_swap_tx
tools.description: The UNSIGNED transaction for a swap, plus the approval it needs and a simulation run as the taker. Nothing is sent: the taker's own wallet signs and broadcasts. Pass a quoteId from chord_quote, or the full parameters.

tools.name: chord_ask
tools.description: Ask Chord's analyst a question in plain language (markets, tokens, wallets, perps, macro). Uses many data sources and takes 10 to 60 seconds. Needs an API key.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint. No key for data and swap tools; chord_ask needs a Chord API key.

examples.title: Token board
examples.description: See what trades most on a chain
examples.prompt: Show the top tokens by 24h volume on Base.

examples.title: Swap transaction
examples.description: Get the best route and the unsigned transaction
examples.prompt: Quote a swap of 1 MON to USDC on Monad for my wallet 0x... and give me the unsigned transaction.
